text.autoconfig.disc_jockey.title: Disc Jockey
text.autoconfig.disc_jockey.option.disab: Will force notes to play synchronously with client ticks instead of in a separate thread.
This can lead to performance loss, especially when you client has low or inconsistent fps but can fix issues when playback does not happen at all.
text.autoconfig.disc_jockey.option.omnid: Makes all note block sounds when playing a song omnidirectional, creating a more pleasing listening experience
If you don't know what that means, I recommend you just try it and hear the difference
text.autoconfig.disc_jockey.option.tunin: Select how fast to tune notes for a song
If you face issues (e.g. due to an AntiCheat or very bad Ping)
and this mod is allowed, select or Safe or, worst case, Snail.
Use Flash if you're sure you don't have any Packet or Interact Limits (usually Vanilla/Fabric Servers).
Any server that limits Packets will probably kick you for this.
A reasonable default is Spigot (assuming Server runs Spigot/Paper or forks which most do).
It is a bit faster than Safe and should work on most servers.
text.autoconfig.disc_jockey.option.playb: When playing a song, the mod will try its best to not exceed this rate limit (leaving some headroom for other activities).
Most servers have a limit around 500 Packets / Second.
Vanilla/Fabric server usually have non, but setting No Limit is rarely ever useful anyway.
Servers with AntiCheat might require you to use a lower setting (but make sure you're allowed to use this mod there at all).
text.autoconfig.disc_jockey.option.delay: Delays playback for specified seconds, after tuning finished, if any (e.g. 0.5 for half a second delay).
text.autoconfig.disc_jockey.option.instr: There have been some instances where a noteblock does not properly detect the instrument it's supposed to be.
This can cause Disc Jockey to falsely report not finding some instruments. However this will probably
break custom block plugins (like Nexo) that wanna alter instruments.
text.autoconfig.disc_jockey.option.autoS: Automatically scroll to the last selected song when opening the menu.
Also auto-navigate to the folder containing the last selected song.
text.autoconfig.disc_jockey.option.remem: Remember the last selected song when restarting the game.
text.autoconfig.disc_jockey.option.showP: Show the playback progress bar on the HUD when a song is playing.
Only visible when no GUI screen is open.
text.autoconfig.disc_jockey.option.autoS: Automatically switch to nearby note blocks when moving during playback(no tune).
When disabled, playback stops immediately if you move too far from a note block.
